digest.component_or_area: ticket store (git repository) and identity verification system
propositions: Execute a quiesced, force-push rewrite of the tickets repository to reclaim space by rewriting git history, contingent on all prerequisite gates (A1-A5, A6-0a/0b/0c/0d, B6) and operator-confirmed zero active sessions and stopped MCP servers

Validate pre-publication that a fresh unfiltered clone is ≤150 MB, commit/merge counts are unchanged, and identity verification event multisets are identical (modulo rewritten SHAs) before and after the rewrite
Record deterministic proof that writers are quiesced: review-bot health in_flight=0, no Gerrit patchsets awaiting LLM-Review, and disabled workflows with no in-progress runs
After the rewrite, prove non-resurrection by asserting the old tip is no longer an ancestor, size-pack growth is <1 MB, and no default-cloned ref contains the old tip
Update the sole literal SHA in the system (rebar.toml identity.enforce_since via Gerrit) to the mapped post-rewrite commit, landing via normal review flow (LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1 / Submit)

Re-enable workflows and services, validate post-window reconciliation either via green reconcile-bridge runs or operator-approved equivalent CLI sequence with zero mutations/recovery failures and canary drift_total=0
